entries.title: Psalms 122:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents. Of David.>> I was glad when they said to me, "Let us go into the house of the LORD."

entries.title: Psalms 122:2
segments: Our feet have been standing Within your gates, O Jerusalem!

entries.title: Psalms 122:3
segments: Jerusalem is built As a city that is compact together,

entries.title: Psalms 122:4
segments: Where the tribes go up, The tribes of the LORD, To the Testimony of Israel, To give thanks to the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 122:5
segments: For thrones are set there for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.

entries.title: Psalms 122:6
segments: ¶Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May they prosper who love you.

entries.title: Psalms 122:7
segments: Peace be within your walls, Prosperity within your palaces."

entries.title: Psalms 122:8
segments: For the sake of my brethren and companions, I will now say, "Peace [be] within you."

entries.title: Psalms 122:9
segments: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek your good.
